questions.question: The grill found a contradiction in my export plan about the numbers in the spreadsheet. The spec says amounts are 'rounded to the rupee' for display, and the screen shows ₹1,00,50,136. But the underlying payload carries exact paise (10050136.29). Someone reconciling the sheet against SAP would want the paise; someone checking it against the screen would want them to match exactly. What should the exported cells contain?
options: Rounded to the rupee, matching the screen (Recommended)
Rounded values, with a paise-exact column alongside
questions.chosen: Rounded to the rupee, matching the screen (Recommended)
